feeds.title: Mollie Hunt: Crazy Cat Lady Mysteries and more
feeds.description: Meet Mollie Hunt, a creator and storyteller specializing in tales that offer insight into the nature of cats. Mollie is the author of the Crazy Cat Lady's cozy mystery series, the Tenth Life paranormal cozies, and the Cat Seasons sci-fantasy tetralogy, where feline heroes embark on a mission to save the world. In addition to her prose, Mollie also crafts cat poetry, adding a poetic touch to her exploration of the feline realm.

feeds.title: Cat Lady in the Canyon
feeds.description: Here at Cat Lady in the Canyon, I am redefining 'crazy cat lady' and in doing such, I provide information about all things feline, from behavior to breeds, ancestry to anecdotes, nutrition and cat care, and loads of cute cat pictures.

feeds.title: Old Maid Cat Lady
feeds.description: This blog was created to share stories and cat care advice with other 'old maid cat ladies' out there, and to support the Old Maid Cat Lady online store. The store closed in 2019, but this blog continues as a repository of cat care information.

feeds.title: Girls and Their Cats Blog
feeds.description: BriAnne Wills is a New York-based fashion and beauty photographer and the creator of Girls and Their Cats. GATC is a photo series created by BriAnne as a way to debunk the crazy cat lady stereotype and showcase cat-owning women in a positive light. She's photographed over 300 women around the US, all as unique as their feline friends.
